result.prior_version_note: Before August 1, 2025, clause (b) read: "At or prior to the commencement of any tenancy, no lessor may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay any amount in excess of the following." It bound only the lessor. The amendment by St. 2025, c. 9, §§ 54-55 extended the limit to an "agent of the lessor" and to payments made "to the lessor or to an agent of the lessor." The documents give no original start date; DX13 (secondary) says only that the law has been in effect "since the 1970s."
